name: Kha'Zix Reroll
summary: An early 3-cost reroll around Kha'Zix, supported by Diana, Hecarim and Ezreal.
playWhen: You have BiS items for Kha'Zix

opener.note: Kha'Zix on stage 2 with a slam.

stages.tip: Pick up the carry's cheap relatives and components. A slam is only worth it if it goes on a unit you will keep.
Hit the opener and start collecting copies of the carry. Hold the components for its BiS items until the carry's copies are on your bench.
Roll at the level the carry is cheapest to find, aiming for a 3-star carry with its items. If copies are contested, check the Scout panel.
